items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I presume you would like to state the name of your wife? Dolores Ferdinand.

ctx.x: But you have this music – you have this degree. You’re back in New Orleans. You’re trying to get gigs. You’ve just recently married. I presume you would like to state the name of your wife?
Dolores Ferdinand. She had gone to Grambling and finished – graduated in home economics, which was considered one of the best home-ec departments in the whole state.
Did you know her before you had gone into the Marines?
